metadata.content:
*You unleash a howl that hurls your enemies back.*

| **Area, [Melee](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/melee), Weapon**    |               **Main action** |
|----------------------------|------------------------------:|
| **📏 5 x 1 line within 1** | **🎯 Each enemy in the area** |

**[Power Roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) + [Might](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/might):**

- **≤11:** 6 damage; [push](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 2
- **12-16:** 9 damage; [push](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 4
- **17+:** 13 damage; [push](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 6

**Effect:** The targets are [force moved](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) one at a time, starting with the target nearest to you, and can be [pushed](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) into other targets in the same line.
